claims.statement: Ben Hogan deposited a $500 forfeit with Jack Looney to fight Tom Allen for $2,000 a side, win or lose, thirty days after the McCoole and Allen fight.
claims.excerpt: $500 as a forfeit with Jack Looney, of 422 North
